sn22.98:1.2: Sitting to one side, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn22.98:1.3: “Is there, venerable sir, any form, any feeling, any perception,
sn22.98:1.7: any volitional formations, any consciousness that is permanent, stable, eternal, not subject to change, and that will remain the same just like eternity itself?”
sn22.98:1.8: “Bhikkhu, there is no form, no feeling, no perception, no volitional formations, no consciousness that is permanent,
sn22.98:1.12: stable, eternal, not subject to change, and that will remain the same just like eternity itself.”
